en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, “Spending a dirham for dye is equal to spending a hundred dirhams in the way of Allah. There are fourteen benefits of applying dye – it stops air from ears, improves eyesight, softens the  root of nose, mouth smells good, jaws become strong, removes the odor of armpits, evil thoughts lessen, angels become happy, it is a cause  of  glad-tidings  for  a  believer  and  suffering  for  a disbeliever,   it   is   the   cause   of   beauty,   fragrance   and avoidance of the hardships of grave and Munkir and Nakir would shy due to dye.”
